name: Atlanta Parts Distribution Center - Buford GA

fieldNotes.location: Positively confirmed: Street View shows a large 'DAIMLER - Daimler Trucks North America' sign on the building wall at the SW corner. Address 2510 Mill Center Parkway, Suite 100, Buford GA — building 'Bldg I', an 870,480 sq ft cross-dock distribution facility (built 2006) in the Mill Center / Hamilton Mill business park. Roster geocode moved 4,842 m; the corrected pin landed on the correct building. DTNA occupies Suite 100 (a portion of the multi-tenant building; Radial and RNC Industries occupy other suites). Center locked at 34.117850, -83.982650.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. Street View shows a black ornamental perimeter fence with a swing gate enclosing the DTNA dock yard, separating the secured truck court from the public car parking lot at the DTNA suite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No guard booth structure at the gate or anywhere on the truck side.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE. There is a controlled truck gate but no guard shack — implies kiosk / badge / app check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with dock doors on both the north and south long faces. The building listing cites 52 dock doors / 152 truck dock positions; 50+ band. Count flagged uncertain because DTNA occupies only one suite of the multi-tenant building.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Truck courts on both faces are packed with parked trailers in angled drop stalls; building listing cites 166 trailer parking stalls. 50+ band, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Roughly 75 trailers counted across the north and south truck courts in captured imagery — estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout: dock banks on two separate building faces (north and south) function as physically separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide 185'-deep truck courts easily stage 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: DTNA's fenced dock yard has a single gated access point used for both entry and exit.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Single gated access into a fenced suite yard; no obvious unused width for an express bypass at the gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single gate lane; exact lane count not resolvable from imagery — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Mill Center / Hamilton Mill business park in Gwinnett County within metro Atlanta's industrial fabric; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
